summary:
# StreamRender-H3 curated racing examples

60 reference-video render requests: 20 scenes in group A and 10 trajectories
with four appearance variants each in group B. Default: B10_e-track-3_bluehour.

The archive contains 30 semantic videos and 60 reference pictures, plus a
SHA-256 inventory. Extract it from models/streamrender_h3 to populate
examples/media/. Request JSONLs and usage instructions are in the sol-engine
branch under models/streamrender_h3/examples/.

Checkpoint download: https://huggingface.co/yitongl/StreamRender-H3

Usage: https://github.com/NVlabs/Sana/tree/sol-engine/models/streamrender_h3/examples

These are prerecorded input examples, not generated output videos or action
transcripts. Contributor permission covers publication of this material;
upstream model and third-party game asset licenses remain applicable.
